scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply PHOTOS --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply PHOTOS --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply PHOTOS --remote -c wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc
